summary: The body and garment shells match the concept front-on and are in budget, but holes (17>10) and trouser navy kept (5.2%<6.3%) fail, the face is blurred, the back has no crossing straps, and the wireframe shows stray long edges.

findings.observation: No crossing back straps (brief identity mark); the concept is front-only.
Eyes blurry smudges, mouth effectively absent; nose a faceted wedge.
17 loops vs 10 (7 body, 3 harness, 1 per other part), possibly by design for open shells; none visible.
Trouser navy kept 5.2% vs 6.3%, yet visibly present; the measurement looks misleading.
Stray long wireframe edges at the waist and spikes at hands/head, not in shaded views. (Orchestrator: measured longest edge 0.20 m vs P1's 0.187 in Phase 0b; a wireframe-render artefact.)

escalation_reason: Unrelated fixes (back straps, face detail at 256 px, whether shell loops are acceptable); the failing assertions look partly misleading.
questions_answered: Matches front; no back straps; blurred face.
All colours pass except trouser navy share.
Eyes faint, nose faint, mouth absent.
